name: Sabrina Mrozinski
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.

name: Tammie Tran
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Hello! I'm a certified practising counsellor with the Psychotherapy and Counselling Federation of Australia (PACFA), working with adult individuals and couples. Working from a non-pathologising perspective, I draw upon evidence-based models, such as a Strengths-Based Approach, Attachment Theory, Trauma-Informed Practice, Internal Family Systems (IFS), Solution-Focused Therapy, and Mindfulness.

name: Katharine Ranken
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: In my practice I hold the Mind-Body Connection as forefront to my therapeutic approach It's important to me that this therapeutic journey is useful and effective for you. With this in mind I will review with you on a regular basis whether the work is meeting your expectations. By invitation and your agreement I use many different body-mind integrated and experiential therapeutic interventions to assist you in working towards your desired outcomes Please see my website for more information

name: Suzanne Hurley
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Perinatal Mental Health & Fertility Counsellor Skype / Zoom / Phone Suzanne is a passionate, dedicated & clinically accredited counsellor (PACFA) who has specialised in the area of reproductive loss, including pregnancy options counselling, abortion counselling, infertility and IVF support and in perinatal mental health. She has provided her clients with counselling, group support and presented to health professionals in various perinatal settings. Her initial training at WIRE Womens's Information has provided her with understanding of the Feminist Framework and responding to family violence & sexual assault.

name: Nerolie Ross
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Passion Counselling focuses on providing mental health support and therapy, predominantly for anxiety and depression as well as other related conditions.

name: Ellen Dharmaraj
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: My aim is to create a safe road to recovery, toward the ultimate goal of not only feeling better, but also to go out in the world on your own with confidence. Whether it is major life challenges, unresolved feelings from the past or anxieties facing into your future, I'm your sounding board backed with accredited training and experience. Many clients say to me that I "just get it" and this is what I do best - helping you feel acknowledged, supported and understood.

name: Sharon Peeters
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Sharon is committed to helping couples work through problems in a proactive and relational manner. Sharon has attained Level 3 Training in Gottman Method Couples Therapy and is undergoing certification to be a specialist. Sharon utilises evidenced based theories to work through issues such as: anxiety, depression, stress and burnout, addictions, boundary issues to addictions, trauma, loss and grief.

name: Nidhi Khanna
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Hi! I am a certified practising Counsellor with experience in working with various presentations, including but not limited to stress, anxiety, depression, trauma and grief. I adopt a trauma-informed approach and draw upon various therapeutic modalities.
